_note: This template is byte-for-byte the config that setup.sh generates in .mcp.json. It contains no user-specific path: the launcher is the bare 'uv' command, --directory is the universal runtime bridge path /opt/mempalace-mcp-bridge, and the palace is /mempalace/palace. On the host those two runtime paths are symlinks created by setup.sh (scripts/runtime_aliases.sh: /opt/mempalace-mcp-bridge -> $HOME/.local/share/mempalace-mcp-bridge, /mempalace -> $HOME/.mempalace). Inside a DevContainer the same two paths exist as bind mounts. That is why one and the same .mcp.json works in both places.
